external_environment_tests.procedure: On an existing PostgreSQL volume, rotate APP_DB_PASSWORD and start the stack without running ALTER ROLE manually.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: Sanitized deploy diagnostics showing db-bootstrap completed and API/Web healthy after the password rotation.

external_environment_tests.procedure: Start the stack with a new PostgreSQL volume and verify that axes_app and its grants are created automatically.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: Sanitized bootstrap and database-role diagnostics proving the restricted role exists, authenticates and has expected grants.

external_environment_tests.procedure: From another machine on the target network, run the external C12 smoke with the trusted CA and complete an authorized browser login.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: External smoke report plus sanitized browser evidence showing trusted HTTPS and successful authenticated access.

external_environment_tests.procedure: From another machine on the target network, request the HTTP origin and verify one redirect to the expected HTTPS CRM origin.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: External smoke output showing an unambiguous 301 or 308 redirect to the expected HTTPS origin.

external_environment_tests.procedure: On the server, verify ports 3000, 3001 and 5432 are bound only to loopback or are otherwise unavailable from the network.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: Sanitized socket/firewall diagnostics proving application and database ports are not exposed beyond loopback.

external_environment_tests.procedure: Run scripts/verificar-deploy.sh on the target server using the expected CRM IP and trusted CA.
external_environment_tests.evidence_required: Sanitized verifier output ending with zero failures.
